bluf: At least seven, and by some counts about ten, European flights received hoax bomb threats on November 3, with four more Prague bound planes threatened on November 5. No devices were found. bluf: Diplomacy and strikes are running in parallel. Qatar says both sides are reviewing a mediators' draft and Tehran offers to reopen Hormuz within two days of a deal, but a reported US strike on Qeshm Island and continued tanker hits show the truce fraying. We assess a framework that reopens the Strait is unlikely before December 31 because the two sides still disagree on what comes first.

Domestic pressure in the US after the midterms
